nodes.title: One post from the system
nodes.evidence: A public post generated from your feed, edited by you, pointing at shipped work.
nodes.why: Edit and publish one proposal from the content system. The post must describe completed work and link to supporting evidence.
nodes.reading: Optional depth work. Choose one draft from the content system, make every claim specific, add a link to the work, and publish the post yourself. General advice copied from another source does not count.
nodes.reviewFor: a post linked to completed work, evidence of your edits, and confirmation that publication required your approval.

tasks.title: Send one post from the feed
tasks.done_when: you have accepted a proposal, edited the draft, and published the post yourself.

proves.claim: You can publish one post about work you can defend and link to evidence another person can open.
proves.challenge: Tighten one engine draft and publish it with a link.
proves.evidence: The live post URL.
proves.falsification: The post repeats general advice, contains no fact from your work, or has no link to supporting evidence.
proves.threshold: The live post came from the content system, describes your work, includes one concrete fact, and links to supporting evidence.
proves.transfer: Two posts in seven days; every post after; the research post.

nodes.title: The search runs without you
nodes.evidence: A pipeline document that records each application target, the supporting work it links to, and the stop condition.
nodes.why: Define a bounded application pipeline that can run while you are away and preserve an exact record of every message sent in your name.
nodes.reading: Optional depth work. Apply the containment contract from You ran it unattended to your job search. Define allowed targets, identity and credentials, budget, stop conditions, and the record you will review and sign. Read Containment and accountability (14) again before the first run.
nodes.reviewFor: each application linked to supporting work, an explicit stop condition, and records sufficient to reconstruct every message sent.

tasks.title: Write and run a contained pipeline
tasks.done_when: your document names the target roles, supporting work for each application, and stop condition, and you have sent at least one application from the document.

proves.claim: You can run an unattended system that speaks in your name, under a contract, and read its results honestly.
proves.challenge: Contain the pipeline, run it a week, measure the replies against a denominator.
proves.evidence: The contract, the week's run record and the numbers at one URL.
proves.falsification: No contract before the first run; applications the record cannot show; a reply rate with no denominator; the system claiming anything your evidence does not support.
proves.threshold: Contract first, a week of auditable records, one tested hypothesis about the numbers.
proves.transfer: Every unattended system you run for an employer uses this contract shape; the record goes in your defense pack.

nodes.title: Two posts in seven days
nodes.evidence: Two public posts within seven days, each linking to supporting work.
nodes.why: Publish two posts from the feed within seven days, approving and editing each one yourself.
nodes.reading: Optional depth work. Publish two posts within one seven-day period. Each post must meet the requirements from One post from the system: your work, a concrete fact, and a link to supporting evidence.
nodes.reviewFor: two posts, seven days, both from shipped work, both edited by you.

tasks.title: Two posts in seven days
tasks.done_when: both posts are public, come from shipped work, and have been edited by you.

proves.claim: You can use the content system to publish useful posts on a repeatable schedule.
proves.challenge: Publish two engine posts inside seven days.
proves.evidence: Two public post URLs with dates.
proves.falsification: Two posts eight days apart; recycled tips; posts not from the engine.
proves.threshold: Two dated posts were published within seven days, both came from the content system, and both link to supporting work.
proves.transfer: The cadence you keep after the cohort ends.
